third_party_evaluations.summary: Professional GCP networking with VPCs, hybrid connectivity, Cloud Armor, and segmentation.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Hybrid connectivity, segmentation and Cloud Armor design support professional network-security responsibility at three years; GCP dependence bounds the portability of the recorded competence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Hybrid connectivity, VPCs, segmentation and Cloud Armor with a three-year profile support professional network-security design. The proctored knowledge signal is useful for GCP staffing but does not show expert practical capability across vendors.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded hybrid connectivity, segmentation and Cloud Armor scope supports professional network design and operations. Vendor dependence and no documented extensive lab limit the tier.
